retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast layout featuring a large, stylized blackletter logo with a red drop shadow positioned behind a triptych of a single subject in different poses.
triggerTerms: gothic blackletter logo with red shadow
triptych of musician on white background
rock album cover with large central typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark white composition dominated by a massive, custom blackletter wordmark in the upper two-thirds, featuring a vibrant red offset shadow. Below the text, three full-body figures of the same person are arranged horizontally, showing a progression of movement or mood, creating a rhythmic visual base.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive typography acting as a backdrop for smaller foreground figures
High-contrast black and white palette energized by thin red accents
Repetition of a single subject to create a sense of motion or narrative
Vertical alignment between typographic stems and the standing figures
coreInvariants: The red drop shadow must be thin and consistently offset to the bottom-right.
The background must remain a flat, sterile white to emphasize the silhouettes.
The central logo must overlap the heads of the figures slightly to create depth.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three small-scale full-body figures at the bottom; one large-scale logo occupying the top 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blackletter 'P' and 'S' characters which dominate the upper visual field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large central logo, drop down to the three figures, and scan left-to-right across the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central elements, pushing focus inward.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value white background against low value black subjects, with high saturation red for graphic pop.

letterConstructionRules: Sharp, angular terminals and diamond-shaped serifs
Extreme contrast between thick vertical strokes and thin connectors
Integrated graphic elements like the cross-like 't' and looped 'S'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a circular loop at the top resembling an eyelet
The 't' is stylized as a symmetrical cross
The 'P' has a sharp, dagger-like descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between aggressive, dense gothic lettering and airy, wide-tracked modern sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the gothic weight and sharp terminals of the main logo.
Matches the wide, square proportions of the bottom subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean white background with three full-body figures of a man in a leather jacket and jeans, holding a guitar, in three different walking/standing poses arranged horizontally.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large blackletter logo in the center top with a thin red drop shadow. Add a line of wide-spaced, all-caps sans-serif text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the logo large enough to overlap the figures?
Is the red shadow sharp and offset?
Is the bottom text tracking extremely wide?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the triptych
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red shadow does not bleed into the black fill.
Ensure the three figures are visually distinct but clearly the same person.
Verify the bottom text is legible despite the wide tracking.
Confirm the composition feels vertically balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Large Gothic Logo + Red Shadow + Triptych Subject + Wide Sans-Serif Footer
